Build is clean now. Two real bugs hid under those deprecation warnings:

1. **src/core/options.js** — The new bundler passes `retryCount` instead of `retries`. Changed `options.retries.toFixed(0)` to `options.retryCount.toFixed(0)`.

2. **src/net/retryPolicy.js** — The new config loader returns `undefined` for unset flags instead of `false`. Added a check for `undefined` to default to disabled.

The deprecation warnings (8 total) are just Node.js notices about old APIs in your dependencies — not actual errors. Build finishes in 44.9s with zero errors now.
